name: safeappeals-case
description: Case setup for Safe Appeals: profile walkthrough, agent-native case briefs (AGENTS.md) and structured case info (.safeAppeals/case.json)

safeappeals.profile.name.description: Your name, as it should appear in case briefs and drafted documents

safeappeals.profile.organization.description: Firm, union, or organization you work for (leave empty if self-represented)

safeappeals.profile.role.description: Your role, e.g. lawyer, paralegal, claimant advocate, self-represented worker

safeappeals.profile.practiceArea.description: Primary area of law you practice

safeappeals.profile.jurisdiction.description: Default jurisdiction for new cases, e.g. BC WCB, Ontario WSIB

walkthroughs.title: Set Up Safe Appeals
walkthroughs.description: Tell Safe Appeals who you are and set up your case folder so the AI agent always has the right context.

steps.title: Set Up Your Profile
steps.description:
Who you are, where you work, and what law you practice. Saved once, globally, and included in every case brief.
[Set Up Profile](command:safeappeals-case.setupProfile)

steps.title: Initialize This Case Folder
steps.description:
Creates the case brief (AGENTS.md) and structured case info for the folder you have open, so the agent knows the client, opposing party, and key dates.
[Initialize Case Folder](command:safeappeals-case.initCase)
